first_author_journal: Bruno et al. (J. Am. Soc. Nephrol.)
donor_source: Human bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells (BM-MSCs)
cargo_class: mRNAs and microvesicle-shuttled surface receptor transcripts (~80-1000 nm MVs)
species_stage: Mouse preclinical in vivo + human tubular cells in vitro
reported_effect: Horizontal mRNA transfer activated tubular proliferation inhibited apoptosis and matched whole-MSC renal functional recovery; RNase abolished protection
clinical_translation_gap: Murine glycerol AKI model; requires standardized human GMP EV potency release assays and randomized renal trials

first_author_journal: Xin et al. (J. Cereb. Blood Flow Metab.)
donor_source: Rat bone marrow mesenchymal stromal cells
cargo_class: 100-nm exosomal vesicular miRNA and trophic protein cargo
recipient_tissue_model: Middle cerebral artery occlusion (MCAO) ischemic stroke
reported_effect: Tail-vein MSC-exosomes (100 ug) significantly increased neurite remodeling synaptic plasticity angiogenesis and motor recovery at 28 days
clinical_translation_gap: Intravenous bolus undergoes heavy hepatic/splenic trapping; rodent MCAO lacks aged human stroke comorbidities

first_author_journal: Long et al. (Proc. Natl. Acad. Sci. USA)
donor_source: Human bone marrow MSC-derived anti-inflammatory A1-exosomes
cargo_class: Immunomodulatory exosomal proteins and small RNAs
reported_effect: Intranasal A1-exosomes reached hippocampus within 6 h curbed TNF-alpha/IL-1beta microglial activation preserved GABAergic interneurons and rescued memory/neurogenesis
clinical_translation_gap: Acute post-insult murine administration window; chronic human epilepsy remodeling untested in Phase II/III trials

cargo_class: hNSC extracellular vesicles carrying neuroprotective trophic/miRNA cargo
recipient_tissue_model: Permanent middle cerebral artery occlusion ischemic stroke
reported_effect: Intravenous hNSC-EVs reduced cerebral lesion volume brain swelling and white-matter diffusivity loss while improving neurological behavior scores in pigs
clinical_translation_gap: Strong gyrencephalic bridge study yet small cohort size and unproven human stroke Phase II/III efficacy

donor_source: Human bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells
cargo_class: Exosomal surface ligands and regulatory RNA/protein secretome
recipient_tissue_model: BTBR T+tf/J idiopathic autism spectrum behavioral model
reported_effect: Intranasal MSC-exosomes crossed BBB selectively accumulated in cortex/cerebellum increased ultrasonic vocalizations and social interaction and reduced repetitive grooming; amniotic-cell exosomes showed no effect
clinical_translation_gap: Behavioral mouse proxy cannot establish human language/cognitive efficacy; cargo mechanism not isolated to a single molecule

first_author_journal: Narbute et al. (Stem Cells Transl. Med.)
donor_source: Human exfoliated deciduous teeth stem cells (SHED)
cargo_class: Small extracellular vesicles (30-100 nm) neuroprotective secretome
recipient_tissue_model: Unilateral 6-hydroxydopamine (6-OHDA) medial forebrain bundle Parkinson model
reported_effect: Repeated intranasal EVs normalized gait parameters and restored striatal/nigral tyrosine hydroxylase dopaminergic expression
clinical_translation_gap: Acute neurotoxin 6-OHDA lesion lacks progressive human alpha-synuclein Lewy pathology

recipient_tissue_model: Systemic NAD+ decline hypothalamic activity and lifespan in aged mice
species_stage: Mouse preclinical in vivo + human plasma correlation
reported_effect: Young EV-contained eNAMPT internalized into target cells boosted intracellular NAD+ synthesis improved wheel-running wheel activity and extended median mouse lifespan ~10%
clinical_translation_gap: Murine female lifespan cohort; human safety and pharmacokinetics of chronic systemic eNAMPT-EV supplementation unproven

cargo_class: Small EVs enriched in glutathione-S-transferase (GSTM2) intrinsic antioxidant enzyme
recipient_tissue_model: Replicative/oncogene-induced senescent cells and aged mouse liver/kidney/serum
species_stage: Mouse preclinical in vivo + human senescent fibroblasts in vitro
reported_effect: Young sEVs restored GSH/ROS redox balance lowered lipid peroxidation and reduced SA-beta-Gal and p16/p21 senescence markers
clinical_translation_gap: Donor-age sensitivity and limited scalability of primary young fibroblast sEV manufacturing

first_author_journal: Losurdo et al. (Stem Cells Transl. Med.)
reported_effect: Two intranasal EV doses dampened hippocampal microglial activation increased dendritic spine density in CA1/entorhinal cortex and showed neuroprotective polarization
clinical_translation_gap: Short follow-up in 7-month 3xTg mice prior to late-stage human-scale neurofibrillary neurodegeneration

donor_source: Human bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells
recipient_tissue_model: Shank3B homozygous knockout monogenic syndromic autism mouse model
reported_effect: Intranasal MSC-exosomes rescued social preference ultrasonic vocalizations and repetitive grooming while upregulating prefrontal GABARB1 transcripts
clinical_translation_gap: Mouse Shank3B rescue does not guarantee circuit reversal in adolescent/adult human Phelan-McDermid syndrome

donor_source: Human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived neural stem cells (hiPSC-NSCs)
cargo_class: Defined miRNA (miR-21-5p miR-103a) and protein (pentraxin-3 AGRN) EV cargo
recipient_tissue_model: LPS-stimulated macrophages/microglia and adult rodent hippocampal neurogenesis
species_stage: Mouse/rat preclinical in vivo + human iPSC-NSC in vitro
reported_effect: Intranasal hiPSC-NSC EVs entered neurons and glia across forebrain suppressed IL-6/inflammasome signaling and enhanced dentate gyrus neurogenesis
clinical_translation_gap: Requires multi-lot iPSC-NSC differentiation consistency and tumorigenicity/off-target biodistribution clearance

donor_source: Human bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells
recipient_tissue_model: 5XFAD aggressive amyloidogenic Alzheimer's disease mouse model
reported_effect: Intranasal MSC-EVs improved novel-object and Barnes-maze memory and lowered hippocampal amyloid plaque load vs vehicle controls
clinical_translation_gap: 5XFAD overexpresses mutant APP/PS1 without human sporadic tauopathy; optimal human intranasal olfactory deposition differs anatomically from rodents

donor_source: Young mouse adipose-derived mesenchymal stem cells (ADSCs)
cargo_class: Small EVs carrying pro-regenerative miRNAs affecting oxidative stress and epigenetic clocks
recipient_tissue_model: Aged frail mice (20-24 months; grip strength motor coordination kidney/muscle)
reported_effect: Two intravenous young ADSC-sEV doses reversed frailty scores improved physical endurance and reduced Horvath DNA-methylation epigenetic age across tissues
clinical_translation_gap: Transient multi-month duration requiring repeat dosing; human geriatric clinical trials pending

cargo_class: ESC-EVs enriched in miR-15b-5p and miR-290a-5p targeting Cdk1/mTOR/insulin pathways
recipient_tissue_model: Late-passage senescent fibroblasts and naturally aged mice
species_stage: Mouse preclinical in vivo + senescent MEFs in vitro
reported_effect: ESC-EVs restored proliferative capacity reduced SA-beta-Gal and rejuvenated multi-organ transcriptomic signatures in aged mice
clinical_translation_gap: Pluripotent ESC-derived miR-290 cluster carries oncogenic/cell-cycle overdrive risks that must be gated before human translation

donor_source: Young mouse and young human plasma
cargo_class: Circulating small EVs enriched in miR-144-3p miR-149-5p and miR-455-3p stimulating PGC-1alpha
recipient_tissue_model: Aged mouse brain heart muscle and cognitive/endurance decline
species_stage: Mouse preclinical in vivo + human plasma sEV profiling
reported_effect: Young plasma sEVs boosted mitochondrial respiratory metabolism reduced amyloid/senescence burden improved cognition and extended aged mouse median lifespan ~12.4%
clinical_translation_gap: Requires synthetic lipid-nanoparticle or recombinant sEV mimicry to avoid reliance on pooled human donor plasma

first_author_journal: Li et al. (J. Nanobiotechnol.) & Chen et al. (Stem Cell Res. Ther.)
cargo_class: Surface-engineered and hypoxia-primed intranasal BMSC extracellular vesicles
recipient_tissue_model: Controlled cortical impact traumatic brain injury (TBI)
reported_effect: Intranasal engineered/hypoxia-primed EVs targeted contused cortex suppressed NLRP3/microglial neuroinflammation and accelerated sensorimotor and spatial-memory recovery
clinical_translation_gap: Rodent cribiform-plate olfactory surface area (~50% of nasal cavity vs ~3-5% in humans) creates a major nose-to-brain scaling barrier for human clinical dosing
